address: Easthampstead Park, Off Peacock Lane, Wokingham,RG40 3DF
bio: Spoil yourself with Afternoon Tea at Easthampstead Park, an impressive Victorian mansion set against a backdrop of lush, green woodland.  Nestled in the stunning Berkshire countryside amidst 60 acres of grounds, Easthampstead Park is the perfect space to relax, unwind and indulge in the most delicious of Great British traditions.  Their traditional Afternoon Tea menu comprises a delicate array of hand-cut finger sandwiches with a variety of fillings and a selection of speciality homemade pastries & delicacies. All served with a pot of loose tea leaf or an infusion of choice.  Easthampstead Park lies right in the heart of Berkshire, just a short distance from Wokingham and Bracknell and within easy reach of the M4, M3 and M25.
